source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.3.2, printed pages 150-151.

blocks.text: Temperature barhane se reaction ki rate barhti hai. Dekha gaya hai ke temperature mein har 10 °C rise (izafe) par rate dugni ya tigni ho jati hai. Temperature ka rate par aam taur par bara asar hota hai. Zyada temperature par molecules ke paas zyada thermal (garmi wali) energy hoti hai, is liye woh zyada baar aur zyada zor se takrate hain.

Boltzmann distribution curve ek graph hai jo kisi temperature par molecules ki energies ki distribution (taqseem, yani kis ke paas kitni energy) dikhata hai. Kuch particles ki energy bohat kam, kuch ki bohat zyada, aur zyada tar ki beech ki hoti hai. Yeh graph Figure 7.6 mein hai aur ise Boltzmann distribution kehte hain. Activation energy woh kam se kam energy hai jo takrane wale particles ko product banane ke liye chahiye. Graph ke neeche shaded (rang kiya hua) hissa un molecules ko dikhata hai jin ke paas takra kar chemical change lane ki kaafi energy hai. Curve ke neeche poora area (raqba) particles ki total number hai; shaded hissa Eₐ se zyada energy wale particles ki number hai.

blocks.alt: Boltzmann distribution: molecules ki number vs molecular energy. Curve zero se shuru ho kar kam energy par peak (choti) tak charhta aur lambi tail (dum) mein girta hai. Vertical line Ea dikhati hai; Ea se aage tail ke neeche ka area purple rang mein hai, saath likha: 'Ea - is energy aur is se zyada par molecules ke paas effective collision ki kaafi energy hai'.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.6: Activation energy ke saath molecular energies ki Boltzmann distribution (kitab ki Figure 7.6 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 7.6 ke y-axis par 'Number of molecular' chhapa hai; sahi 'Number of molecules' hai. Curve ke neeche poora area tamam molecules hain; Eₐ ke daen purple hissa woh molecules hain jin ke paas react karne ki kaafi energy hai.

Reaction mixture ka temperature barhayein to particles ki average kinetic (harkat wali) energy barhti hai. Particles tez chalte hain aur zyada baar takrate hain, is liye successful (kaamyab) collisions ka proportion (hissa) bohat barh jata hai (Figure 7.7). Zyada temperature wala Boltzmann curve neecha aur chapta ho jata hai aur us ki choti (peak) daen taraf khisak jati hai. 10 °C rise par shaded hissa taqreeban dugna ho jata hai. Result (nateeja): temperature barhane se reaction ki rate barhti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Figure 7.8' likhti hai; do temperatures wale curves asal mein Figure 7.7 mein hain. Figure 7.8 catalyst wala energy diagram hai (7.3.3).

blocks.alt: Do temperatures par fraction of collisions vs collision energy, T2 > T1. Blue T1 curve ki peak unchi hai; pink T2 curve neecha hai aur us ki peak daen khiski hai ('The peak lowers and shifts to the right'). Orange dotted line Ea (activation energy) hai. Ea se aage T1 ke neeche ka area dark blue aur T2 ke neeche ka bara area pink hai: 'Greater fraction with enough energy to react'.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.7: T1 aur T2 temperatures par molecular energies ki Boltzmann distribution (kitab ki Figure 7.7 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neela curve T₁ (kam temperature) aur pink curve T₂ (zyada temperature) hai. Eₐ wali line ke daen pink hissa neele se kahin bara hai: zyada temperature par zyada molecules ke paas react karne ki kaafi energy hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Boltzmann distribution curve kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh kisi ek temperature par molecules ki number ka un ki energy ke muqable graph hai. Is ka ek peak (choti) hai aur zyada energy ki taraf lambi tail (dum). Curve ke neeche ka area total molecules, aur Eₐ se aage wala hissa react kar sakne wale molecules dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) 10 °C rise reaction ki rate ko taqreeban dugna kyun kar deta hai?
blocks.explanation: 10 °C garam karne se curve daen khisakta aur chapta hota hai, aur Eₐ se aage wala area taqreeban dugna ho jata hai. Yani taqreeban dugne molecules ke paas activation energy hoti hai, dugne collisions effective hote hain aur rate taqreeban dugni ho jati hai.

items: Har 10 °C rise par rate taqreeban dugni ya tigni: molecules tez chalte, zyada baar aur zyada energy se takrate hain.
Boltzmann distribution: Eₐ se aage wala area react karne wale molecules hain; temperature barhne par yeh area barhta hai.
